connector.name: Datasignals Lab MCP
connector.registryDescription: Insider trading, 13F, 8-K, Form D, FDA, Congress, crypto: scored signals. Free flagship, 17 tools.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.apify.com over streamable HTTP. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.datasignalslab, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
